So my plan is to use the real Compiler class to build an AbstractCompiler instance, parse actual source into an AST, and then invoke TypedScopeCreator.createScope() against it.

Since the real test setup in Defects4J relies on CompilerTypeTestCase, I need to replicate that minimal harness manually without that base class, using only JUnit and the specified libraries.
